summary.name: ImageOptim
summary.one_liner: ImageOptim is a free, open-source macOS app that compresses images to reduce file size and strips metadata such as EXIF information.
use_cases: reduce image file sizes before uploading to a website
remove private EXIF data from photos before sharing
save disk space by compressing image folders
speed up web page image downloads
optimize PNG, JPEG and SVG files on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: ImageOptim compresses images by applying optimization that aims to preserve quality, reducing file sizes so they take less disk space and download faster. It removes metadata such as private EXIF data from digital cameras, embedded thumbnails, comments, and unnecessary color profiles. It combines several existing open-source optimizers, including MozJPEG, pngquant, Pngcrush, 7zip, SVGO and Google Zopfli. The page lists it as free and open source and quotes reviews from MacWorld and MacStories.
notable: Bundles multiple open-source optimizers (MozJPEG, pngquant, Pngcrush, 7zip, SVGO, Zopfli) in one app
Removes EXIF metadata, embedded thumbnails, comments and color profiles
caveats: Mac-only; the page lists no other platforms
